description: Implementation of Huffman tree builder for data compression, including node management, tree construction, and serialization functions.

classes.name: HuffmanNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the Huffman tree, storing value, count, and child nodes.

methods.name: RecordUsage
methods.description: Records the usage count of a character.

methods.name: ToTable
methods.description: Converts the Huffman tree into a table representation.

methods.name: TreeToTable
methods.description: Recursively traverses the Huffman tree to fill the table with encoding info.

methods.name: ToVector
methods.description: Serializes the Huffman tree into a vector of bytes.

methods.name: WriteToVector
methods.description: Helper function to serialize a node and its children into a byte vector.

methods.name: BuildTree
methods.description: Constructs the Huffman tree based on character counts.
